result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, conditional cyber, and certificate requirements, but omits workers’ compensation as required by law. It also adds an unsupported one-year post-termination coverage obligation, so it is not minimal. The existing commercial terms are otherwise preserved. Drafting is generally understandable, but placing Section 14.11 after the execution recital is structurally awkward, and the cyber trigger uses inconsistent/unclear terminology (“Corio or Customer data”). The margin comment does not cure the operative omission.
